levels.note: Vortex-style remote syscall service. /drifter/drifter0 + its full C source are world-readable; the daemon chroots to /home/drifter0/chroot (drifter0.password, 33 bytes, mode 400), drops to uid 19000, listens on 1111, and executes arbitrary i386 syscalls from RC4-encrypted 36-byte frames. Keymat = the 4-byte source IP + 2-byte source port AS THE SERVER SEES THEM (getsockname() on the client; getpeername() gives the SERVER's port - the first desync). Both streams skip 42*6=252 keystream bytes; key_in/key_out are independent RC4 states. Syscall gadget: mmap2(0x10000000,4096,RW,MAP_PRIVATE|MAP_ANONYMOUS,-1,0) for scratch memory (fd 4 = the accepted socket, found by fstat-scan since lseek can't distinguish EBADF/ESPIPE); data is delivered by sending the read(4,buf,n) frame FIRST and the raw bytes right after (the server consumes them from the socket); exfil is write(4,buf,n) whose n raw bytes arrive on the stream BEFORE its own 4-byte RC4 reply. The daemon sees the client's REAL source IP - running the client ON the backend (via any game's ssh) gives keymat ip 127.0.0.1.
